sentence: This project studies how a fungus that destroys rice controls the release of proteins into host plant cells.
This project uses microfluidic technologies to measure how proteins bind DNA and other proteins to turn genes on or off.
This project builds a real-world testbed for an open radio access network to find out how a Zero Trust security approach protects it.
This project builds a hybrid model that combines process-based modeling with deep learning to study how climate change and urbanization affect local urban climates.
This project measures how gases of atoms confined in one dimension behave when an additional lattice makes them harder to model.
This project studies how human epidermal stem cells change as they form skin grown in a dish, using computational tools that look at single cells.
This project studies how ions move through amorphous solids, using computer simulations and machine learning to find materials for safer batteries.
This project supports a web accessible data repository of 3D image data of specimens from museum collections.
This project studies how organizations can protect private information in data used to train AI while keeping the models useful.
This project holds a conference where scientists discuss statistical and quantitative problems in genetic and genomic research on diversity.
This project tries to find out whether computations with matrices can be done faster and what kinds of methods would be needed.
This project combines label-free two-photon microscopy with deep learning to tell tumor types apart.
This project builds biohybrid jellyfish with pressure and temperature sensors and tests how well they can measure the ocean.
This project asks how the elasticity of soft, water-filled networks guides the way proteins gather and organize.
This project builds a shared database of semiconductor device data and machine learning models for researchers to use.
This project studies how neurons in the mouse cerebellum travel to their final place and how a family of adhesion proteins guides them.
This project builds deep learning algorithms that help operators of electric power systems plan operations that deal with uncertainty from renewable energy.
This project builds quantum algorithms that make Monte Carlo methods faster for statistics and decision-making under uncertainty.
This project builds interactive machine learning tools that help plant scientists label images of plant roots taken by cameras in the soil.
